item.title: Roller Skating on the Point Returns in March
item.description: Roller Skating on the Point returns to the Charleston Harbor Resort and Marina on select days from Friday, March 6, through Sunday, March 29, 2026.

item.title: Philosophers & Fools to Celebrate Second Birthday With All-Day Party
item.description: Philosophers & Fools will host its second birthday party on March 7, 2026. The bookstore bar will celebrate all day with curated wine and beer tastings, special pop-ups and exclusive gifts with purchase.

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Charleston Wine and Food Festival Director Alyssa Smith
item.description: Quintin Washington of Quintin's Close-Ups recently spoke with a Charleston news maker. You can watch the interview below.

item.title: Golden Corral Brings Back All-You-Can-Eat Butterfly Shrimp & Steak
item.description: Golden Corral, the nation’s go-to buffet for variety and value, is welcoming its All-You-Can-Eat Butterfly Shrimp & Steak back to its lineup, giving guests a hearty, premium meal at an unbeatable price during the Lenten season and beyond.

item.title: BCLS Launching 2026 Seed Library for Spring Gardening
item.description: Berkeley County Library System (BCLS) customers can access a catalog of seed packets for a variety of vegetable, pollinator and herb seeds.

item.title: The Citadel’s presidential search committee announces four finalists
item.description: The Citadel’s presidential search committee has announced the four finalists to become the college’s 21st president.

item.title: Women Build Week 2026 – Raising Walls and Hope on Johns Island
item.description: Sea Island Habitat for Humanity announced that, thanks to the overwhelming generosity of community supporters and dedicated participants, it has successfully raised over $130,000 to fully fund the materials cost for the 2026 Women Build home.

item.title: The Isling at Savannah Harbor Welcomes Greg Hall Custom Homes to Builders Guild
item.description: Trilogy Investment Company, a fully integrated residential development and investment company, today announced that Greg Hall Custom Homes has joined The Isling at Savannah Harbor’s Builders Guild

item.title: Preston Smelt Announces Candidacy for Dorchester County Council District 7, Pledging to End Rampant Growth and Prioritize Infrastructure
item.description: Preston Smelt, a community advocate and resident, has announced his candidacy for Dorchester County Council District 7.

item.title: Why Austin Brands are Partnering With Creative Marketing Agencies for National Growth
item.description: From indie startups to established lifestyle labels, Austin brands are thinking bigger than Texas. To scale nationally, many are turning to creative marketing partners who can translate local energy into broader impact.
